text: 金十数据7月18日讯，入伏以来，持续性高温天气席卷国内多地。国家能源局此前预计，2026年全国最大电力负荷在15.75亿至16亿千瓦，若出现大范围极端高温天气可能超过16亿千瓦。业内预计，2026年全国全社会用电量同比增长5%至6%，供需呈总体平衡态势，夏季局部地区平衡偏紧。依托“十五五”万亿级电网投资，我国新型电力系统建设提速。专家指出，新能源消纳与储能装机建设仍是转型核心，需火电及核电等短期托底、市场化政策长期协同发力，筑牢全年电力保供根基。
text_en: Jin Shi Data, July 18 - Since the start of the 'dog days,' persistent high temperatures have swept across many parts of China. The National Energy Administration previously estimated that the national maximum power load in 2026 will be between 1.575 billion and 1.6 billion kilowatts, possibly exceeding 1.6 billion kilowatts if widespread extreme heat occurs. The industry expects national total electricity consumption in 2026 to grow 5% to 6% year-on-year, with an overall balanced supply-demand situation, though locally tight in summer. Leveraging trillion-yuan grid investments in the '15th Five-Year Plan,' China's new power system construction is accelerating. Experts point out that new energy consumption and energy storage construction remain core to the transition, requiring short-term support from thermal and nuclear power alongside long-term coordinated market policies to secure the foundation for full-year power supply.
